metadata.name: Kitsune inbox
metadata.description: Sorts the notes kept since the last pass: each goes to its list, its reminder or its specialist, then a short summary.

steps.name: Sort the notes
steps.prompt: Read the recent notes with kitsune (action recent, limit 30) and take those without the tag "trié". For each one, call the triage sub-agent with its text, then act on its answer: add its items to their lists (kitsune add_items), set a reminder when one was said, and tag the note "trié" (kitsune tag). Do not delete anything.

steps.name: Say what changed
steps.prompt: In three short lines, in the person's language, say what was sorted: how many notes, what went to which list, which reminders were set. Nothing to fix, no guilt.
